dedupe_keys.name: a unified approach to quantifying the key greenhouse gas emissions air pollutant emissions and water demand in concrete production

description: Sabbie Miller at the University of California Davis publishes a workbook of life-cycle inputs and environmental-impact calculations for cement and concrete. Zenodo provides the Excel file free under CC0. The documented coverage is California production technologies, including greenhouse gases, nitrogen and sulphur oxides, particulates, volatile organic compounds, carbon monoxide, water consumption and water withdrawal. Inputs are structured for adaptation to other regions and imported constituents. These factors can support embodied-emission and resource-demand simulations for infrastructure construction. No related catalogue record explicitly covers this workbook. Coverage follows the study’s materials and technologies, not current measured performance of every plant. Observation years, workbook equations and detailed uncertainty are not established by the landing description. Regional transfer requires replacement of local energy and process assumptions. No workbook was downloaded, formulas evaluated or life-cycle result independently reproduced.
